title: Sequential Monitoring of Item Parameter Drift
text: Window estimates. Rasch difficulty per item per window, examinee ability known operational scoring. Standardized deviation bank: z = (b_t - b_bank) / sqrt(SE_t^2 + SE_bank^2). Two-sided CUSUM z (reference value k, threshold h). Threshold tuning design. dw_tune() regenerates responses drift program’s actual items, windows, sample sizes examinees, reruns estimation CUSUM. matters: item’s bank error shared every window accumulates CUSUM. design-based threshold (h ≈ 9.4) far iid-normal one (≈ 6.9), former hits false-alarm target. Gradual vs abrupt. Step ramp models fitted profiled change point, log likelihood ratio decides . weak evidence type undetermined rather guessed. Impact action. True-score scoring impact keeping, removing recalibrating flagged items. Actions retire, recalibrate remove anchor set, written rationale, threshold settings, analyst timestamp.

title: Sequential Monitoring of Item Parameter Drift

Score impact (60-item form 12 drifted items, cut theta = 0.5): keeping banked values mis-states pass rate -1.3 points; recalibrating flagged items cuts -0.2 points, removing -0.15.

title: Sequential drift monitoring — dw_monitor
text: Runs two-sided CUSUM item's standardized deviations `z_t = (b_t - b_bank) / SE`: `S+[t] = max(0, S+[t-1] + z[t] - k)` likewise downward. alarm raised first window either statistic exceeds `h`. Drift type classified comparing step ramp fits difficulty series (profiling change point), using data `followup` windows alarm. `change_point` onset better-fitting model; `cusum_change_point` standard CUSUM estimator (window statistic last left zero), locates abrupt changes well lags gradual onsets.

title: Sequential drift monitoring — dw_monitor
code: dw_monitor(estimates, h, k = 0.5, followup = 3, min_log_lr = 1)

title: Sequential drift monitoring — dw_monitor
text: estimates `dw_estimates` object. h Alarm threshold, ideally [dw_tune()]. k Reference value (half shift, SE units, chart tuned detect). followup Windows alarm used classify change (`Inf` = data date). min_log_lr Minimum log likelihood ratio step ramp models type assigned; weaker evidence gives `"undetermined"`. Soon alarm ramp step often told apart; rerun windows resolve .

what: Tune the alarm threshold for a bank-wide false-alarm target — dw_tune
title: Tune the alarm threshold for a bank-wide false-alarm target — dw_tune
text: item raises false alarm monitoring horizon exactly maximum CUSUM statistics exceeds `h`. `h` `1 - target` quantile maximum drift. `method = "design"`, null simulated program's design: items, windows, examinee abilities sample sizes, responses regenerated banked difficulties, re-estimated re-standardized exactly monitoring. captures small-sample non-normality `z` sparse windows. `method = "normal"` treats `z` iid N(0, 1), fast useful planning bank exist yet.

title: Tune the alarm threshold for a bank-wide false-alarm target — dw_tune
code: dw_tune(   estimates = NULL,   target = 0.01,   k = 0.5,   method = c("design", "normal"),   n_rep = 20,   n_windows = NULL,   seed = NULL )

title: Tune the alarm threshold for a bank-wide false-alarm target — dw_tune
text: estimates `dw_estimates` object (required `"design"`). target Probability non-drifting item alarms least horizon. Expected false alarms bank = `target * n_items`. k Reference value ([dw_monitor()]). method `"design"` `"normal"`. n_rep Null replicates whole bank (`"design"`) simulated item series (`"normal"`). n_windows Horizon `"normal"` (default: estimates' windows). seed Optional seed.

title: Tune the alarm threshold for a bank-wide false-alarm target — dw_tune
text: list: `h`, `target`, `k`, `method`, `expected_false_alarms`   (per bank, estimates given), `null_max` (simulated   maxima).

title: Tune the alarm threshold for a bank-wide false-alarm target — dw_tune
code: sim <- dw_simulate(n_items = 60, n_windows = 20, mean_n = 60,                    onset_range = c(5, 12), seed = 1) est <- dw_estimate(sim$responses, sim$bank) dw_tune(est, target = 0.02, method = "normal", seed = 1)$h #> [1] 5.373496 # \donttest{ # Design-based tuning (recommended) simulates the whole bank n_rep times. dw_tune(est, target = 0.02, n_rep = 5, seed = 1)$h #> [1] 5.44248 # }

title: driftwatch 0.1.0
text: Initial release. Window-level Rasch difficulty estimation (dw_estimate()). Two-sided CUSUM monitoring change-point estimation gradual/abrupt classification (dw_monitor()).
